title: Reference Visual Contract Lock

source_of_truth.reference: User-approved Page 3 mockup shown in chat on 2026-09-27 at 23:30 UTC
source_of_truth.instruction: Match the approved mockup composition, hierarchy, spacing, grouping, and visual weight. Do not satisfy this contract with a CSS skin over the old composition.
source_of_truth.dynamic_content_rule: Player, team, opponent, logos, values, matchup metadata, historical values, market state, and chart data remain live and may vary; their placement and visual hierarchy must match the reference composition.

global.team_color_rule: Real team colors/logos remain authentic and are used as localized hero accents only.
global.surface_style: dark navy/black layered cards with restrained glow

reference_regions.required_composition: Brand left; sport navigation right; one compact horizontal bar.
One unified matchup card: home/team block left, player portrait and identity center-left, opponent block right, game metadata along bottom.
Five equal-width stat cards in one row at reference width.
reference_regions.mobile_rule: Horizontal scroll or responsive wrapping is allowed only when needed; card hierarchy and tap/readability must remain intact.

reference_regions.required_composition: Single bordered control deck with header row, Manual Line Lab action at upper-right, then two equal control cards beneath.
reference_regions.selected_state: bright glacier-blue glow with strong filled/outlined state
reference_regions.interaction_rule: Existing Streamlit controls remain real, tappable controls; do not replace with static HTML.

reference_regions.required_composition: One Line Lab card with title/subtitle left, manual-line disclaimer right, large centered current line value, and a full-width interactive slider beneath.
reference_regions.interaction_rule: Existing analysis-line slider semantics, min/max, selected value, callbacks, and recalculation behavior must remain unchanged.

reference_regions.required_composition: One live historical recalculation panel with four equal summary cards.
reference_regions.truth_rule: Values come only from frozen verified history calculations.

reference_regions.required_composition: Full-width game-by-game results card with title left, compact legend right, vertical bars, opponent/date labels, and a dashed analysis-line reference.
reference_regions.truth_rule: Chart values and over/under/push classification remain frozen product truth.

exactness_rules: The implementation must materially change composition, not only colors, borders, shadows, or typography.
At reference/tablet width, Hero, Quick Stat Ribbon, Analysis Settings, Line Lab, Live Recalculation, and Game Chart must appear in this exact vertical order.
At reference/tablet width, the quick-stat ribbon must read as five distinct equal cards.
At reference/tablet width, Analysis Settings must read as one parent deck containing two side-by-side control cards.
At reference/tablet width, Line Lab must read as one cohesive module with the large current-line value visually centered above the slider.
The lower analytics area must visually separate live recalculation from the game chart while retaining a single cohesive system.
Do not hide data from the approved mockup to achieve visual parity.
Do not introduce sportsbook projections, probabilities, recommendations, stake sizing, or wager actions.

future_step_map.scope: Line Lab + lower analytics/chart composition rebuild
Full integration, accessibility, responsive and public certification

freeze_rule: Once Step 1 is GREEN + FROZEN, this contract file is immutable unless the user explicitly changes the approved visual target.
